# telnyx_notification_profile (Data Source)

A notification profile, which groups the notification channels that account notifications are sent to.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Identifies the notification profile.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) ISO 8601 formatted date indicating when the resource was created.
- `name` (String) A human readable name.
- `updated_at` (String) ISO 8601 formatted date indicating when the resource was updated.
